data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"If token-budget exhaustion is predictable, resumption is safe provided the system injects a synthetic barrier event before the forced crash.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If exhaustion is abrupt and unpredictable (e.g., a hard kill or OOM), no synthetic barrier can be injected, and resumption must be refused.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the synthetic barrier itself is corrupted because the warning was triggered too late, leaving the barrier event partial.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"A warning threshold (e.g., 90% budget) triggers a controlled suspension, emitting a synthetic barrier event that cleanly delimits the committed log up to that point.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
